description: Land Title Settlement Department - Unagalwehera East, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120034 (24/0079)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details (all parcels are registered to "The State"). The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
